definition.value: The total monetary value of all final goods and services produced within a country in a given period.
La valeur monétaire totale de tous les biens et services finaux produits dans un pays sur une période donnée.
Gross domestic product divided by the population of the country.
A measure of the average change over time in the prices paid by consumers for a basket of goods and services.
